Input.description:
A native input element that automatically works with [Field](/react/components/field).
Renders an `<input>` element.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The default value of the input. Use when uncontrolled.

props.name: value
props.description: The value of the input. Use when controlled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Callback fired when the `value` changes. Use when controlled.

props.name: class
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: render
props.description: Replace the default element with a tag name, component, or render function.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the input is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-valid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the input is in a valid state (when wrapped in Field.Root).

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the input is in an invalid state (when wrapped in Field.Root).

dataAttributes.name: data-dirty
dataAttributes.description: Present when the input's value has changed (when wrapped in Field.Root).

dataAttributes.name: data-touched
dataAttributes.description: Present when the input has been touched (when wrapped in Field.Root).

dataAttributes.name: data-filled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the input is filled (when wrapped in Field.Root).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present when the input is focused (when wrapped in Field.Root).

additionalTypes.name: Input.State
Input.ChangeEventDetails
